description: I wanted to test out Lens Protocol but am busy during the week. I participated in this hackathon to have a deadline, because having a deadline pushes me to actually do things instead of letting them fall behind schedule. For the project, I took a boilerplate repo from a friend and followed the lens protocol quickstart guide to familiarize myself with the protocol and options. I learned how it works and am excited to use the protocol in future projects.
